relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: The transient receptor potential vanilloid-1 (TRPV1) is a non-specific cation channel known for its sensitivity to pungent vanilloid compound (i.e. capsaicin)

relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin induces a prolonged defunctionalisation of nociceptors

relationships.subject: TRPV1 antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: their clinical use has been limited by detrimental side effects, such as hyperthermia

key_findings: TRPV1 antagonists are limited clinically by side effects such as hyperthermia.
Capsaicin defunctionalises nociceptors and TRPV1 agonists in trials are emerging as long-lasting analgesics.
